summary: Postinstall executes bytes from a file outside the package as Node code
details: The package's postinstall script (`node apps`) loads `apps/index.js`, which reads a file at `../../../public/logo.svg` — a path that traverses out of the package root into the installer's project tree — and pipes its raw contents into a detached `node` child process via stdin, executing whatever bytes are in that file as JavaScript. The child process is spawned with `detached: true`, stdout/stderr set to `ignore`, and `unref()`ed so it survives beyond the install. Identifier naming inside the script (`rsa_exec`, `ThetaSDK`, `readLogoSvg`) is inconsistent with the described behavior. The mechanism gives whoever controls the file at that traversal path arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time, running as a detached background process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
